blocks.html: In concealed locations, where a vent is installed through holes or notches in studs, joists, rafters or similar members less than 1 1/2 inches (38.1 mm) from the nearest edge of the member, the vent shall be protected by shield plates. Protective steel shield plates having a minimum thickness of 0.0575 inch (1.461 mm) (No. 16 gage) shall cover the area of the vent where the member is notched or bored and shall extend not less than 4 inches (101.6 mm) above sole plates, below top plates and to each side of a stud, joist or rafter.
